title: An explicit round-S4 spin twist has charge one and chiral index one
axiom_use: Full AC is inherited through the pinned compact elliptic/Hodge Green and Chern–Weil supplier interfaces; no Atiyah–Singer theorem or physical premise is used.

references.title: Konstantin Wernli, Lecture Notes on Spin Geometry
references.locator: §§1.5.2–1.5.3, printed28–30/PDF29–31, and §§2.3.3–2.3.5, printed68–72/PDF69–73; Clifford chirality, spin representation, induced spin connection and Dirac operator. The explicit round-S4 Hodge intertwiner and index calculation are supplied locally.

references.title: Wang, Wen and Witten, A New SU(2) Anomaly
references.locator: §§2.1–2.2, PDF6–9/printed5–8; real five-dimensional Dirac structure, fixed-background center transformation and periodic product-kernel parity. Its Atiyah–Singer index value is replaced here by the local Hodge calculation.
